title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1-olivia-chen
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep for upcoming Security & Compliance review (SOC2 + ISO readiness)
Owner: Olivia Chen
Date of review: planning for week of 2026-03-16 (internal dry-run 2026-03-09)
Attendees (planned): Aaron Patel (SRE), Maya Thompson (Product Ops), Jamie Chen (Infra), external auditor contact TBD
Goals for 1:1 with Aaron:
- Quick status check on evidence collection for SOC2 CC controls and ISO27001 Annex A mappings.
- Identify any high-risk vendor integrations missing up-to-date contracts or AICPA-type attestations.
- Confirm owners for artifacts the auditor will request and timeline to produce them.
- Surface any open gaps requiring leadership escalation.

Agenda draft:
1) Quick status summary (5 min)
   - What artifacts are complete vs in-progress (e.g., access matrices, change control logs, incident response runbooks, vendor risk assessments).
2) Evidence deep-dive (20 min)
   - IAM: list of SSO configured apps + 3rd-party access review (last review date?)
   - Change management: recent PRs/approvals for infra changes in scope window, timestamps and approvers
   - Logging & monitoring: retention evidence, alerting runbooks, examples of responded alerts
   - Backup & DR: last successful restore test and runbook link
3) Vendor risk & contracts (10 min)
   - Identify vendors without SOC2/ISO cert or missing Data Processing Addenda (DPAs)
   - Shortlist vendors to prioritize for vendor questionnaires and evidence requests
4) Audit logistics & timeline (5 min)
   - Confirm dry-run date and who will present each control family
   - Identify escalation path for responses we cannot produce in time
5) Action items & owners (5 min)

Current snapshot (notes to self):
- IAM: Okta config doc exists but last export is from 2025-11-02. Need up-to-date user access CSV and recent group membership changes (owner: Maya).
- Change control: GitHub approvals are present but we lack a consolidated change log PDF. Action: generate signed export from repo (owner: Jamie).
- Logging: CloudWatch/Datadog retention policies documented; need evidence of alert resolution examples within the audit window (owner: Aaron).
- Backup & DR: Weekly snapshot & incremental backups configured; last DR runbook test was 2025-09 (out of date). Need to schedule tabletop and capture results (owner: Olivia).
- Vendor risk: 6 vendors flagged as high impact (data access) — need current SOC2 reports or completed vendor questionnaire. Top two: VectorAnalytics (no SOC2), SecureTranscribe (SOC2 type II expired 2024). Action: send vendor questionnaire and escalate to procurement if no response by 2026-03-05 (owner: Olivia + Procurement).

Open questions to bring to 1:1 with Aaron:
- Do we have a consolidated list of in-scope systems for the upcoming audit window? If not, can we finalize today?
- Are there any outstanding privileged accounts that were provisioned but not tied to an approval ticket?
- Which alerts (by name) will be used as evidence of monitoring/response? Can we pull 3 recent incidents as examples?
- Any planned infra changes in the 2-week lead-up to the audit that would affect evidence continuity?

Planned action items (with tentative deadlines):
- Generate up-to-date Okta user/group export (Maya) — due 2026-03-03
- Produce consolidated change log PDF from GitHub review history (Jamie) — due 2026-03-04
- Export 3 incident response examples & associated pager duty playbooks (Aaron) — due 2026-03-04
- Schedule DR tabletop test and capture runbook + test evidence (Olivia) — schedule by 2026-03-06, test by 2026-03-12
- Vendor questionnaire outreach to VectorAnalytics & SecureTranscribe (Olivia + Procurement) — send by 2026-03-01, escalate by 2026-03-05 if no response
- Create one-pager for auditor summarizing scope, system list, and control owners (Olivia) — draft by 2026-03-06

Risks / blockers:
- Several vendor attestations are expired or missing; procurement bandwidth is limited this week.
- DR test is overdue — may be called out in audit if not completed before fieldwork.
- Evidence exports sometimes lack signatures/timestamps auditors expect; may need supervisor attestations.

Prep notes for the meeting (talking points):
- Emphasize pragmatic plan: we will provide partial evidence with timelines for outstanding items instead of promising immediate completion.
- Ask Aaron to prioritize incident examples and alert resolution logs — these are high-value for auditor review.
- Confirm who will be point for auditor questions during the dry-run and fieldwork (recommend Aaron for infra, Maya for access controls).

Follow-up after 1:1 (template to send to attendees):
- Summary of decisions, assigned owners, delivery dates (capture in JIRA-SEC-213).
- Links to artifacts generated during the week.
- Next sync: 2026-03-06 (30 min) to review outstanding items before dry-run.

Notes to self: keep this doc informal — it's a prep scratchpad. Move finalized action list + artifacts links to the SOC2 Audit Runbook page in Confluence once stable.
